body:
## Problem

`lib/run-switch.test.sh` (254 lines, 5 checks) — the regression suite for the `lib/run-switch.sh` safety guards — is run by no workflow, flake check, or justfile recipe. The guards it pins protect the laptop's NixOS switch path, and today they are verified nowhere in automation.

## Evidence (verified this run, laptop primary @ main ca698a867a)

- `lib/run-switch.sh:4` — header: "Guards (issue #3753, issue #3817): flock refusal of overlapping invocations, evaluated-commit logging, HEAD-moved warning (the 2026-11-01 gen-524 sequence)". `lib/run-switch.sh:2` — "Canonical source for ~/run-switch.sh" (the deployed laptop switch entrypoint).
- `lib/run-switch.test.sh` pins all three guards plus exit-status preservation: concurrent invocation refused without contaminating a log; single invocation prints a unique log path and preserves the rebuild exit status; the switch log records the evaluated commit and tree state; the gen-524 drill (HEAD moves during the build) is caught loudly naming both commits; refusal names the running switch's evaluated commit.
- Hand run on the laptop at ca698a867a: `bash lib/run-switch.test.sh` → all 5 checks ok, "all run-switch tests passed", exit 0.
- Wiring search: `git grep run-switch.test.sh` over the whole repo returns no references outside the file itself. The sibling lib suites are wired — `.github/workflows/scripts-test.yml:42` runs `bash lib/sops-atomic-writers.test.sh`, and `bws-freshness.yml` runs `lib/bws-to-sops-check.test.sh` / `lib/bws-freshness-drift-issue.test.sh` — but no step runs run-switch's suite.

## Why it matters

run-switch is the script that activates new NixOS generations on the laptop. Its flock and evaluated-commit guards exist because overlapping switches and a mid-build HEAD move (gen-524) already caused real confusion once (#3753/#3817). If a guard regresses, the failure mode is two concurrent switches clobbering each other's logs or a generation silently built from a different commit than the log claims — and nothing in CI would notice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A step in `.github/workflows/scripts-test.yml` (natural home, beside the `lib/sops-atomic-writers.test.sh` step at line 42) or equivalent wiring runs `bash lib/run-switch.test.sh`.
- [ ] The wiring demonstrably executes the suite — its output reports "all run-switch tests passed", never a silent skip (assert the file exists first, per the house pattern).
- [ ] The suite passes on main after the wiring lands, and scripts-test stays green.

Dedup: searched open + closed issues for `run-switch.test`, `"run-switch" test workflow`, and `run-switch` — no issue covers wiring this suite; #3753/#3817 are the closed guard fixes the suite pins.
